purpose: predeclared rollout-only calibration; no optimizer and no API
selection_rule: lexicographically first train task not used by calibration v1, one per task type

upstream_alignment.note: Transformers top_p=1.0 is untruncated multinomial sampling; no explicit top-k filter is passed.

gate.note: Zero-variance groups contribute zero GRPO gradient and are allowed, but at least one of four groups must have nonzero within-prompt reward variance.
